recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血可見一顆嗜酸性球（橘紅色粗顆粒）與兩顆嗜中性球；右圖大腸黏膜固有層充滿嗜酸性球，隱窩上皮受損、隱窩腔內有嗜酸性球與碎屑（箭頭），在自體移植後背景下符合以嗜酸性球為主的腸道 GVHD 樣表現。
features: PB: an eosinophil with coarse orange-red granules and bilobed nucleus alongside two segmented neutrophils
Colonic mucosa with crypts lined by columnar epithelium and goblet cells
Lamina propria expanded by numerous eosinophils with a mixed inflammatory infiltrate
Crypt injury with intraluminal eosinophils and cellular debris (arrow) and surface epithelial damage (arrow)
Apoptotic crypt epithelial cells are suggested but not clearly resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil and segmented neutrophils. Colonic biopsy shows preserved crypt architecture with a lamina propria markedly infiltrated by eosinophils, with eosinophils and debris within a damaged crypt lumen and injury to the surface epithelium. Crypt epithelial apoptosis, the key diagnostic lesion of gastrointestinal GVHD, should be specifically sought on higher-power examination. In a patient after autologous stem cell transplantation, with infection and drug effect excluded, the findings are consistent with colonic graft-versus-host disease presenting as eosinophilic colitis.

ddx.dx: Mycophenolate mofetil or other drug-induced colitis
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps (apoptosis, eosinophils); drug exposure history is the discriminator, as MMF colitis often shows more prominent eosinophils and crypt architectural distortion.
CMV shows enlarged endothelial or stromal cells with intranuclear and cytoplasmic inclusions, confirmed by CMV immunohistochemistry.
Parasitic colitis shows larvae or ova within crypts or lamina propria, which are not seen here.

ddx.dx: Primary eosinophilic colitis or allergic colitis
ddx.vs: Primary eosinophilic colitis lacks the transplant setting and does not show prominent crypt epithelial apoptosis.
